evidence.title: GitHub - sadmann7/sortable: Sortable built with shadcn/ui, radix ui, and dnd-kit.

name: Sortable
summary: Headless sortable component built with shadcn/ui, Radix UI and dnd-kit, for lists, forms and tables.
description: A sortable built with shadcn/ui, Radix UI and dnd-kit, bootstrapped with create-t3-app. It integrates with react-hook-form's useFieldArray and TanStack Table, uses Next.js, Tailwind CSS and Zod, and has a live demo at sortable.sadmn.com.
contains: headless sortable primitives built with shadcn/ui, Radix UI and dnd-kit
Next.js + Tailwind CSS, bootstrapped with create-t3-app
